accessibility.description: Castle Crashers Access adds speech for menus, character selection, the world map, shops, equipment, and level results. Enemy radar, boss health and attack announcements, terrain sounds, and a walking guide assist navigation and combat. It supports the Steam version on Windows, keyboard and controller input, and screen readers through Prism, with Windows speech as a fallback. This is a test build: the author reports playing through the Cyclops' Fortress, with later levels not yet checked.
